method: Every suite below was actually executed this session (not summarized from prior claims). Vitest suites ran via `npx vitest run <path> --reporter=verbose`, redirecting combined stdout+stderr to a log file under test-evidence/pt-11/logs/ and appending a literal `exit_code=N` line captured from the shell's own $? immediately after the process exited. Playwright suites ran via `npx playwright test <spec> --project=<name> --reporter=list` with the same log+exit_code capture. The migration suite ran via `npx tsx scripts/check-migration-idempotency.ts` (static analysis + live BEGIN/ROLLBACK spot-check against the real DATABASE_URL — no data was committed). The custom platform smoke script ran via `npx tsx scripts/platform-smoke-test.ts` (read-only live Supabase queries). counts.passed/failed/skipped are parsed directly from each tool's own final summary line, quoted verbatim in `summary_line_verbatim` for independent verification against the raw log.
